notes: Copy for a run and pass with tools/scene_author.py --agent-config. No secrets here: credentials reach the agent only through the variables named in env_passthrough.
agent is the agent-harness backend config (same keys as the expert-harness adapter 'agent' section): backend claude | codex | codex-metered | fake.
price_table is resolved relative to this file; it only prices sessions that report no cost.
wall_s_per_round caps one agent session; max_budget_usd_per_round is passed to backends that support a session budget (null = none).

sandbox: every agent session runs inside an OS sandbox (default mode bwrap, falling back to proot; unshare is refused because it turns the allowlist into a denylist). mode none is an explicit opt-out and is recorded in the call ledger. proot selects the binary (null = DATAFARM_PROOT_BIN or PATH); python selects the interpreter prefix the guest must see to run tools/simready.py (null = this interpreter's base prefix); extra_ro adds read-only host paths.

Physics gate: the host runs `tools/scene_assemble.py check` with this Isaac Lab interpreter against the kept attempt layout and the same prepared dir. Acceptance requires check to pass; without an interpreter the run refuses unless --kinematic-only is passed (recorded in attempts.jsonl and the report).
python: Isaac Lab interpreter (null = --check-python, then $ISAAC_PYTHON). env_script: bash script sourced before check, e.g. an Isaac Lab activation script (null = none).

These tolerances are the single source of truth; the host forwards each one as an explicit tool flag. joint_tol_active bounds actuated/held joints. Passive (non-actuated) joints have no drift bound: they pass when the measured value stays inside the joint limits and their node gains no new contact pair; joint_tol_passive only decides when a passive joint is reported as moved.
